title: Private credit’s exposure to ailing software industry is bigger than advertised | Mint
summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. and other funds have significant exposure to software companies, with discrepancies in categorization across funds. Blackstone and Ares funds have large investments in software, while Apollo reclassified a company from hardware to software. There's also inconsistency in categorizing companies with software components.
sentiment_reason: The article presents routine news about investment exposures and categorization differences, which have a neutral market impact as they reflect ongoing investment strategies rather than immediate market-moving events.
